ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Biotech Wuxia
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Biotech in a wuxia key for Convergence: Era of Cultivation. It reuses the systems of Biotech instead of inventing new ones:
- Puppet Master (reinterprets the mechanitor): the Puppet Heart Thread gives full mechanitor control; wood, bronze and jade puppets (mechs) are built in a puppet workshop from puppet blueprints, spirit thread and spirit wood or metals (no components, no electricity). Puppets grow stronger with the realm of their master, recharge from the qi network, and a broken puppet hurts the master. - Blood Demon cultivator (reinterprets the sanguophage): a xenotype that cultivates with blood essence, retreats in a blood pool and uses blood techniques. Not evil by definition: the method is blood, not the morals.
Requires Biotech, Convergence: Era of Cultivation, Convergence: Formations and Convergence: Resources.
